memories.content: Photosynthesis simulation should use interactive tap-to-add water and sunlight to observe chloroplast reaction
Fractions must always show visual split bars before introducing numerator and denominator notation per Section 2 and 9.
For Class 6 Science on Evaporation, wrong options must never be 'water disappearing'; the explanation must distinguish thermal kinetic energy from destruction.
Universal Scope Mandate: AASHA covers any school, any board (CBSE, ICSE, State Boards, NCERT), any class (Class 1-10), and any subject. Index concepts by universal pedagogical competencies.

Universal Experience Reuse Mandate: NEVER build from scratch when prebuilt open-source foundations exist (PhET, MicroSims, JSXGraph, Escapp, QuestJS). Adhere to AashaExperienceContract (mount, getState, reset, destroy, telemetry).
Same-Frame Mobile Viewport Rule: Concept card and interactive Canvas simulation must fit in the same screen without scrolling on mobile. Tap-to-select only, minimum 44x44px touch targets.

Anti-Spoiler Misconception Policy (Rule #1): Wrong option feedback must never leak correct answers, numbers, or steps. Provide 4-stage progressive hints: Attention -> Relationship -> Strategy -> Procedure.
Mathematical Insulation & Bilingual Substrate: Always insulate LaTeX math and variables with __AASHA_MATH_X__ before LLE word wrapping. Ensure 100% dictionary coverage in window.WM with offline TTS.
Dual-Benchmark Certification: Chapters must pass 100/100 on qa_ltruth_benchmark.js (0 spoilers, 0 math collisions) and 0 console errors on headless Chrome automated_browser_verification.js.
